_comment: Synthetic duplicate-pair fixtures for Phase 2 cluster_dedupe_node testing. All data is fake. Groups items by pair_label — items sharing a label should end up in the same cluster; items with different labels should not.

pairs.description: Identical tweet URL bookmarked at two different times. Text is byte-for-byte the same. A deduper should merge these unconditionally.

items.title: Episodic memory retrieval latency is the bottleneck nobody…
items.text: Episodic memory retrieval latency is the bottleneck nobody talks about. At 100ms per lookup you're burning your context budget before the agent even starts reasoning.

items.title: The future of agent memory isn't bigger vector stores — it's…
items.text: The future of agent memory isn't bigger vector stores — it's smarter consolidation. Weekly distillation passes that compress episodic traces into semantic summaries.
